scripts.typecheck: ./web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && ./web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/agent-runtime/tsconfig.json && ./web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/host-daemon/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:conformance && ./web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.//test:deploy-smoke: Deliberately NOT in the root `npm test` chain, and asserted to be absent by scripts/deploy-smoke.test.mjs. It needs a built web bundle (`npm run build --prefix web`, which also needs `npm run typecheck` for packages/*/dist) and a Chrome or Chromium plus a matching chromedriver on PATH; the root gate must stay runnable on a bare checkout with neither. The suite asserts the bundle is there and says how to produce it; it never builds one itself. The CI job that provisions both and runs it is `smoke-probe` in .github/workflows/ci.yml, where a missing browser is a failure and never a skip.
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:daemon && npm run test:cli && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
